g.text: Granular AI rate limiting | Logical architecture
APIM enforces the decision; Python owns policy, pricing and accounting. Cloud-neutral responsibilities, not a deployment diagram.
Trusted actual usage REPLACES the hold.
Reported cache subsets use their pinned prices.
Provider TPM / RPM limits remain independent.
BLUE: request / accounting GREEN: shared state PURPLE dashed: portal GRAY dotted: telemetry / read-only observation
Responses return along the same route. Stream-to-Engine is an in-process call, NOT an HTTP call to the control Function.
